name: TOP Posters
description:
Automatically generates movie and TV series posters with multi-source rating badges (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Trakt, TMDb and more). Episode thumbnails with rating overlays are also supported for Premium users.

All preferences — language, badge style, badge order, thumbnail position — are managed from your personal dashboard at top-streaming.stream.
overview: Movie and TV posters with multi-source rating badges.

versions.changelog:
